name: Vesicobullous diseases (pemphigus / pemphigoid)
general: Confirm with biopsy + DIF (and ELISA for Dsg1/Dsg3, BP180/230). Score PDAI/BPDAI. Wound care, oral hygiene, nutrition; screen TB, hepatitis B, diabetes, bone health; PPI, calcium + vitamin D with steroids.
special: Bullous pemphigoid: Ointment Clobetasol 0.05% whole body (≤40 g/day, taper over 4 months) is first line; oral prednisolone 0.5 mg/kg if extensive; doxycycline 200 mg/day + nicotinamide as steroid-sparing; methotrexate, dupilumab or omalizumab if refractory. Stop DPP-4 inhibitors (gliptins).

rx.dose: 1 g IV, repeat after 2 weeks (RA protocol)
rx.dur: Maintenance 500 mg at 6 and 12 months if needed
